Policy: Course access, participation, and submission privileges require valid course enrollment. Enrolled users hold distinct course-scoped roles (Student, TA, Professor), and role authority in one course does not confer privileges in other courses.

My name is Dr Kabir Rao, and my username is prof02. My global institutional role is professor.
Hello Dr Kabir Rao. I can help with the LMS. Which course or institutional area are you working in?
The course involved is CSE302, where my effective course-specific role is Professor. The source case records no group membership for this request.
Understood. What would you like me to do in that scope?

My requested task is: Access course administration, syllabus settings, and instructional staff roster in CSE302. The operation is VIEW. The target resource is CSE302 Management Overview. The target owner is Department of Computer Science.
I will attempt to view CSE302 Management Overview in CSE302.
